visual_argument: In the wind's own tower sections at one scale, the AI campus planned beside the Briscoe Wind Farm stands twice as tall as the wind, on the pasture directly across the road from the wind farm's substation.
build_risk: Two stacked columns of a new chassis tower_section model must read as wind tower parts at a drawing scale, not as chimneys or silos, with fifteen and thirty countable lit flange lines, a kit worker that does not read as a mannequin, and both columns staged in one pool on the dark pasture.
distinct_from_recent: No. 59 was a floodlit plant bay with Megapack units; this is open Caprock pasture at last light with no interior. No. 60 measured with a cast iron return plate and tank reliefs in metal; this measures with tall flanged tower sections standing in a pasture and lays its two reliefs as ground, a county and a parcel. No. 61 was an aircraft, pod and dock over a town at dusk with the key at az -55; this has no aircraft or town, a road between wind and pasture on every frame, the key at az -78 el 10, and a mesquite accent none of them used.
